integrity: The strict derivative sign has a complete elementary proof with a quantitative variance bound; finite numerical and exact-rational checks are supplementary, not independent certification. Literature comparison is bounded and historical priority is not guaranteed.
scientific_limitations: Planar regular polygons with inradius one, isotropic Euclidean Minkowski outer offsets, parameter t>=0. Large-n expansion holds for fixed t; no arbitrary convex-body or two-parameter uniformity claim.
title: Strict Mahler-product growth along circular roundings of regular polygons
